mathematical_meanings: Left image: y denotes the unknown angle measure between the upward rays, in degrees. Right image: y denotes the unknown angle at the top vertex, in degrees.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at y° between the two upward rays; the right occurrence is at y° near the top of the right triangle. Both use the selected notation for the same unknown-angle variable role. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
